title: The Administrators of Meaning: A Total Axial Negation Graph
creator: Author left for ratification per metadata protocol
description:
A v1.1 **Total Axial Negation Graph** arranging fourteen nodes from political economy, labor studies, cultural capital, academic enclosure, digital extraction, and AI research around the unoccupied concept “administrators of meaning.”

The graph does not claim to prove its thesis through a conventional empirical sample. It asks what each literature can name, where each stops, and what negative shape remains when their limits are placed together. The resulting sentence concerns a class that mediates between meaning-makers and retrieval/composition surfaces while experiencing enclosure as opportunity, even as the extraction degrades the renewable semantic substrate on which the system depends. The body leaves authorship for ratification and labels itself a deposit candidate.
